name: billocr-review-viewer
description: Ported from 837-claim-viewer (github.com/AB-Kevin/837-claim-viewer): decodes a built .837/.txt file and displays it, restyled to match BillOCR Review. Its own small Vite/TS build -- review-app's main app has no build step of its own; this is the one piece that genuinely needs one (canvas rendering, real X12 parsing), kept self-contained rather than dragging Vite/TypeScript into the rest of review-app.
